title: Skipping the template starts a blank role with all permissions off
custom_preconds: 1. The template picker is open with no template selected.
custom_steps:
1. Skip the template.
  2. Look at the page that opens.
  3. Scroll to the permissions.
  4. Check every card.
  5. Check the Page Access section.
  6. Check the Cross-Cutting Toggles.
custom_expected:
The Create Role page opens.

Every card box is unticked.

Every Page Access toggle and every Cross-Cutting Toggle is off; the Parts Department card is off.
evidence: UI: Skip opens /roles-permissions/new blank — WO View off, Customers View off, Schedule View off, Reports off, See Financial Data off (all permissions off).
